summary: Comprehensive backend testing of Voice Command System for hands-free encounter control. All 41 tests passed (100%). Voice Commands support 10 command types with wake word 'Hey Justice'. Command parsing works with/without wake word and is case-insensitive. Badge 3803 correctly returns James Garcia with accountability score 40.2. Rights responses are contextual based on encounter type (traffic_stop, pedestrian_stop, home, arrest) and topic (search, silence, identification, warrant, detention, miranda).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Voice Command System fully tested. 10 commands supported: start_recording, stop_recording, alert_attorney, panic_button, know_rights, officer_lookup, share_location, add_note, get_status, help. Wake word is 'Hey Justice' but commands work without it. Badge 3803 returns James Garcia with accountability score 40.2. Rights responses are contextual based on encounter type (traffic_stop, pedestrian_stop, home, arrest) and topic (search, silence, identification, warrant, detention, miranda). /test endpoint works without auth for command parsing. /process endpoint requires auth for command execution.
